name: Storm (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
Crackling with electricity, storm hags are found anywhere they can ride the storm winds. Their families are blessed with power over lighting, rain, and wind.

Family Spells: shocking grasp (3rd), invisibility (6th), lightning bolt (9th), ice storm (12th), call lightning storm (15th), chain lightning(18th)
Ritual Spells–Knowledge (Nature): freedom of movement (5th), communal air walk (7th), mass cat’s grace (9th), greater teleport (11th), screen (13th), elemental swarm (air only) (15th), anchored* control weather (17th), empowered storm of vengeance (19th)
Family Powers: Storm hags grow increasingly connected to the storms and their rage.
Storm Winds (Su)

You are constantly surrounded by whipping winds. All ranged attacks made with physical weapons are –4 to hit you and any ranged attacks you make with physical weapons suffer the same penalty. You may deactivate or reactivate this ability as a swift action.

Wind Tricks (Su)

At 4th level, you can spend a soul point as a standard action to trip or disarm a foe within 30 feet. You use your paragon hag class level plus your Charisma modifier to resolve this attempt rather than your CMB. This attempt provokes attacks of opportunity as normal, but only from foes that threaten you.

Storm Rider (Su)

At 8th level, you can fly as the spell while in strong or stronger winds. You can no longer be can be checked or blown away by wind (unless you choose to be), nor do you suffer any fly penalty when flying through wind. At 16th level, your movement rate while flying this way increases by 30 feet.

Lightning Claws (Su)

At 12th level, your claws gain the shocking weapon enchantment. When you reach 20th level, they are considered to have the shocking burst enchantment instead.

Storm Resistance (Ex)

At 16th level, you gain resistance to electricity 20 and sonic 20.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, you can cast lightning bolt at will as a spell-like ability. By spending a soul point, you may cast it as a swift action or have the lightning bolt deal an additional 10d6 sonic damage.
